decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment uses only the firm's general recruiting and crewing processes and sits far from its maritime knowledge base, which limits its ability to read early results and improve the service, but low running costs and an expanding firm make a short trial period likely to continue.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's crewing centres, seafarer pool, training and compliance know-how, so the firm can readily absorb market feedback and refine the offer.
